verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows llamafile exposes extensive CLI arguments (e.g., --cli, --server --help covering HTTP/API/Web UI/sandbox options) and is built atop llama.cpp, which is the kind of product where memory-locking/mmap toggles would be a natural CLI knob, so the axis clearly applies. However, no citation in the pack ever mentions mlock, mmap, or any low-level memory/engine override flag specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or community confirmation of --mlock/--no-mmap or equivalent flags being exposed and usable.
